findings.rationale: At current HEAD 73f93a471e595795b1701e46b0667bd64ecb988e, Gemini and Vercel both invoke executeToolCalls (src/modules/gemini-agent-harness/tool-loop.ts:138 and src/modules/vercel-agent-harness/adapter-tools.ts:70). agentHarnessToolExecutionOptions forwards autonomy mode, guardrails, approval queue, client approval, idempotency, and canUseTool, while executeToolBlock performs policy assessment before execution. This was remediated after the trigger head by daaa70e30. The focused adapter policy suites passed.

AgentSession now retains its owning runtime queue in src/core/loop/loop-constructor.ts:100, and src/core/loop/loop-send.ts:250 passes that queue and scope directly into execution. enqueueToolApproval fails closed when no explicit queue is supplied and enqueues only into that queue (src/core/tools/tool-runner-approval-queue.ts:20-30). Only the default ProjectRuntime installs the compatibility singleton. The concurrent two-project enqueue, listing, approval, execution, and scope-mismatch regressions passed.

The default project-owned state root is now prepared as an inode-anchored DaemonStateRoot. Its isolated helper rejects symbolic links, opens directories and ownership files with O_NOFOLLOW, verifies file identities, and publishes files through private descriptors. src/core/daemon/daemon-instance-lock.test.ts:188 verifies that a symlinked .kota root is rejected without changing or writing to its target, and the focused suite passed. Explicit operator-configured state directories remain a separate trusted case.
